title: Island of Ithaca Bets on Tourism After The Odyssey
paragraphs: The small Greek island of Ithaca is famous as the home of Odysseus, the hero of the ancient Greek poem The Odyssey by Homer. Now, people on the island hope that a new Hollywood movie will bring many more tourists.
The movie, The Odyssey, was directed by Christopher Nolan, and it was released in 2026. It tells the story of Odysseus's long journey home to Ithaca after the Trojan War.

Ithaca is in the Ionian Sea, off the west coast of mainland Greece. It has clear water and beautiful beaches. However, it is far from Greece's most popular tourist places, and it has never had very many visitors.

Some tourists have already come because of the movie. For example, an Italian lawyer, Giorgia Ongarato, said that she studied The Odyssey as a child. "I love Odysseus. This is my dream," she said. Visitors can see a statue of Odysseus and visit an exhibition in the village of Stavros. It shows old objects that, according to some experts, connect today's Ithaca with the home of Odysseus.

However, the island's mayor, Dionysis Stanitsas, said, "There still isn't a large increase in visitors to the island because of the film." He believes tourism will grow, but he said the effect will be clearer next year. Spyros Kouvaras, an archaeologist, expects many more visitors from next year, even in quiet months such as October and April.

There is one problem, though. The movie was not filmed on Ithaca. Instead, the island in the film is Favignana, a small Italian island near Sicily, and some people on Ithaca are disappointed about this. In addition, some people worry that too many tourists could cause problems for small islands.
Still, many people on Ithaca believe that the island's real attraction is not the movie, but Homer's ancient story.
